How it works

From enquiry to plated, in four steps.

  1. Tell us about your event

    Date, location, headcount and what you'd like on the menu.

  2. Get a custom quote

    Priced by headcount and the menu you choose.

  3. Finalise the menu

    We adjust dishes and quantities until it fits.

  4. Delivered on time

    Our team brings everything to your venue.

Questions

Good to know.

What events do you cater?

Corporate events and office lunches, parties and home events, university events, weddings, buffet setups and bulk orders.

Do you cater small parties at home?

Yes. Birthdays, family gatherings and house parties are welcome. Tell us your headcount and we'll build a menu to fit.

Which areas do you cater in?

We cater across Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman and Abu Dhabi.

How is catering priced?

Every quote is custom, based on your headcount and the menu you choose.

Do you do buffet setups?

Yes. We set up full buffets at your venue, from office lunches and house parties to weddings, with the menu built around your headcount.

Is your catering halal?

Yes. All our catering menus are 100% halal.

Can we choose our own menu?

Yes. Pick any mix of appetisers, main courses, salads, desserts and beverages, in Indian, Arabic, Continental, Italian, Chinese or other flavours.

How do I get a catering quote?

Fill in the form on this page, or message us on WhatsApp at +971 50 251 3033 with your date, location and headcount.
